resources.string: Ask for Face ID, Touch ID or BiometricPrompt when you open a protected screen. Optional.
Turning this off gives access to no server credential. Server authentication stays independent from this device setting.
Hide content in the app switcher
Cover the transcript when the app goes to the background. On by default.
Ask the OS to block captures. Off by default; independent from the app-switcher cover.
On Android this blocks screenshots and screen recording too (FLAG_SECURE). The app-switcher cover stays available either way.
Screen capture blocking is not available on this platform. The app-switcher cover still hides the content.
Removes the local data this app stores on this device. The server is never changed.

This erases, on this device only:
• the live authenticated session (disconnect)
• your server credential (SecureStore)
• the stored server profile and its identity pin
• the encrypted cache (database, sidecars and key)
• the notifications posted by the app

Your server, its sessions and its messages are not touched. The cache is rebuilt from the server on the next connection.
Local data erased. Connect to a server to build the cache again.
The erase did not finish. Some local data may remain.
Authentication was cancelled or failed. Nothing was erased.
